# OverCue 0.9.0

For CDJ-3000 firmware 3.22, supporting the guarded RK3399 and R8A7796
hardware profiles.

- Adds per-stem Volume mode with touch-and-drag level controls and blue fill indicators.
- Keeps Toggle as the default, preserves levels between modes, and allows returning
  to Toggle only when every stem is fully on or off. New tracks reset to full level.
- Lets the whole Toggle/Volume selector act as one touch target.
- Makes local detailed stem waveforms follow volume changes while retaining a
  continuous baseline at silence.
- Fixes incorrect stem-track matching when loading music from other linked players.
- Fixes local-USB playlist reordering when deleted library entries reuse active track IDs.
- Keeps native panel communication active during RK3399 installation to improve automatic reboot completion when reinstalling.

Existing prepared stem media remains compatible. Linked fractional-volume waveform
display is not added.
